name: Smart Favorites
overview: Smart playlists built from the shows you have favorited
description: Keeps a per-user playlist of the next unwatched episodes from every series marked as a favorite. Refreshes on server start, on a schedule, and shortly after a favorite is toggled or an episode is finished.

versions.changelog: Targets Jellyfin 12 and .NET 10. No functional changes from 1.2.1.0 — the plugin's API surface is unchanged between 10.11 and 12.x. Servers on 10.11.x are unaffected and stay on 1.2.1.0.

Fixes watched episodes surviving a refresh. Playlist contents are now replaced outright via UpdatePlaylist instead of remove-then-add, and the up-to-date check reads the stored playlist rather than a possibly stale copy. Duplicate playlist names are now logged.
Sort direction is now configurable per playlist (Default, Ascending, Descending). Series with no value for the sort field stay at the end in both directions. Release workflow is restricted to master.

Rule-based playlist filters. Define any number of playlists, each matching series on favorited status, genre, studio, tag, name, content rating, series status, community/critic rating, year, days since added, or days since last watched. Existing configurations migrate automatically.
Refresh on library additions/removals and configuration changes, not just user data. Scheduled task drops to a 24h backstop.
